name: Mild Beef Bulgogi or Non-Spicy Dakgalbi
whyItWorks: Thinly shaved ribeye or chicken marinated in soy sauce, sugar, garlic powder, and sesame oil digests effortlessly because the meat is shaved paper-thin.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve over steamed white rice and skip raw onion slices or gochujang chili paste.
